description: N-gram (PLE) embedding lookup reference fixture for Qwen4ExpTextNGramEmbedding.forward(input_ids, past_key_values=None), the module injected at decoder layer index 1 (config.ple_layer_ids=[2], one-indexed) via Qwen4ExpTextPLELayer. These are REAL embedding row VALUES read directly (via HTTP range requests against the safetensors shard files, never downloading the full ~102GB table) from the real Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next checkpoint at the exact row indices the real hashing formula produces for the six hand-chosen test_token_ids below -- not a synthetic/random table.

source.note: On disk the table is split into 128 row-contiguous shard_N.weight tensors (config.split_ngram_parts=128); transformers concatenates them into one nn.Embedding(320001536, 160) at load time. row_indices below are absolute row numbers into that concatenated table.

dtype: float32 (values) / int64 (ids and indices), little-endian, raw flat binary, row-major (C order)
notes: token_ids: the 6 hand-chosen test tokens (no EOS among them).
row_indices[pos][head]: absolute row into the flat padded [320001536,160] table used for that (position, head) pair -- 16 heads total (8 bigram heads + 8 trigram heads, ngram_size=3).

flattened_embed[pos][:] == per_head_embed[pos].flatten() -- this is exactly the tensor Qwen4ExpTextNGramEmbedding.forward() returns for this input (its final `.flatten(-2)`), BEFORE it is added into the hyper-connection stream by Qwen4ExpTextPLELayer.

Verified against the REAL module: the row-index hashing formula (splitmix64 layer multipliers, XOR-mixed shifted-token-history, prime-sized per-head vocab, offset) was cross-checked row-for-row against a live Qwen4ExpTextNGramEmbedding instance at small scale (see docs/QWEN4_PREVIEW_REFERENCE.md) since the real vocab (320M rows) cannot be instantiated in RAM here; the row VALUES themselves are the real checkpoint bytes.
